number: 第二百四十八条の四の三十
heading_en: Measurement of CVA for Each Counterparty
summary_ja: SA―CVA採用最終指定親会社は、ネット感応度の計測のため、取引相手方ごとにCVAを計測する。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA measures CVA for each counterparty in order to measure net sensitivities.
paragraphs: In order to measure the net sensitivity listed in Article 248-4-8, paragraph (1), item (i), an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA shall measure CVA for each counterparty as provided in the following Article through Article 248-4-35.
